blocks.text: Ceramics sakht (hard) lekin brittle (jaldi toot jane wale) materials hain. In ka melting temperature bohat zyada hai aur yeh bohat achhe insulators (bijli aur garmi na guzarne dene wale) hain, is liye zyada temperature aur bijli ke kaamon mein kaam aate hain. Chemically in mein silicates aur alkali metals, alkaline earth metals aur aluminium ke oxides ka mixture hota hai, jaise K₂O, Na₂O, CaO, Al₂SiO₅ waghera. Mazboot bonds aur fixed structure ki wajah se ceramics mein strength (mazbooti), durability (der tak chalna), aur corrosion (zang) aur heat se bachao jaisi bohat achhi properties hoti hain. Isi liye yeh bartanon (pottery), furnaces (bhattiyon), tiles aur sanitary ware (porcelain), khirkiyon aur optical fibres (glass), aur spark plugs (alumina) mein use hote hain. Ceramics ki properties aur un ke uses ka khulasa Table 31.2 mein hai.

blocks.caption: Table 31.2 Ceramics ki properties aur un ke uses
rows: Bohat zyada temperature par bhi solid rehte hain.
Steel furnaces ke andar refractory (garmi sehne wali) eenton ki tah.
In par kharonch (scratch) dalna ya ghisna bohat mushkil hai.
Abrasives (maslan sandpaper mein silicon carbide) aur kaatne ke auzaar.
Bijli ki taaron (power lines) par porcelain insulators.
Corrosion aur chemicals ke asar se bohat mehfooz.
Chemical processing ki machinery par ceramic coatings.

items: Ceramics: silicates aur oxides (K₂O, Na₂O, CaO, Al₂SiO₅); sakht, brittle, high melting, insulators.
Uses: refractory bricks, abrasives, porcelain insulators, chemical coatings.
